title: Six More Issuers Object to OKXICE Tokenized-Stock Trading
why_it_matters: The growing opt-out list further narrows OKXICE's potential launch inventory and shows issuers using the SEC framework's venue-specific objection right before trading begins.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Six More Issuers Object to OKXICE Tokenized-Stock Trading

OKXICE's October 23 notice adds Arm, Wells Fargo, Moderna, Cisco, Intuit and Marvell, raising its disclosed issuer-objection count from 16 to 22.

Full analysis →
